capabilities: Toggle visibility of completed [x]/[X] tasks vault-wide
Hide sub-bullets indented beneath completed tasks in edit modes
Trigger toggling from the ribbon or command palette
Show current hide/show state in the status bar
extras: Sub-bullet hiding works only in Edit/Live Preview mode; in Reading view sub-bullets hide automatically with their parent. Works on desktop and mobile.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to quickly hide completed tasks across the vault while keeping custom task statuses visible.
summary: Task-visibility toggle that globally hides or shows completed [x] tasks, with ribbon, command, and status bar controls.
